'''Erbaly Nap'tee''' was an old [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] woman who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was a frequent patron of [[Dannar's Claim]], where her interactions with [[Annileen Calwell]] were typified by dementia that prevented her from remembering Annileen or any other employees of the Claim.<ref name="Star Wars: Kenobi" />
